readings.source_reading: The b005, b007 and b071 lines contain title words only: 'Annapūrṇasahasranamastotra', 'Aparādhasundarīstotra' and 'Vairīharaṇakālikākavaca'. No shelfmark, extent, date or number is visible on them.
readings.evidence: Native tiles: each line contains only the title, apart from the underline under b005 and the pencil 'all' in the margin. Nothing else is written on these lines.

Small faint letters at about y 1665-1700 above the 'Gu' of 'Gurugītā'. They lie closer to the Gurugītā line than to the cancelled Kośalakhaṇḍa line at about y 1610. The dots under 'ṇḍa' belong to the cancelled line. Placement does not settle the attachment.
In the native tile (0,3216) the second vowel of the b064 line is a closed o-shaped form. It contrasts with the 'Parama-' of b062 and b066 on the lines directly above and below.
Native tile (1604,3216) shows 'Laksmīpaddhati'. No dot is visible under the 's', whereas a dot appears under 'ṇḍ' in Rudracaṇḍī on the line above.

It stands at the top of the right column, level with Annapūrṇa. It is written in the same hand and at the same indent as the right-column items, with no underline. The columns run A–P on the left and B–V on the right, so a P- item at the head of the right column fits a continuous sequence. Its role is still not confirmed.

(4) A hooked arrow pointing up at the Rāmanāma line, about [2090,4290,70,45]. (5) An arrow right of Vaṭukadīpadāna that runs right and then down, about [2910,3525,100,70]. (6) A left-pointing return arrow below Vagalamukhīstotra, about [2900,3900,70,50].
